item.title: Litigation Kiosk 1.7
item.description:
- Deadlines next week board: the "Deadlines in Next Week" view as cards grouped by day, with a per-day count strip
- Tap an owner on any deadline card to see all their open cases with the next outstanding deadline on each
- Chevron to collapse the kiosk header
- Adam prompt now states the real sender, domain, subject and date as authoritative headers so sender-based rules are judged correctly

item.title: Litigation Kiosk 1.6
item.description:
- Deadlines board: the Legal Case "Deadlines Today" view as cards on the kiosk, under the tiles or on its own tab; deadline type, overdue/due today, case, client v other party, owner, claim no, court, last updated; refreshes every 5 minutes
- Faster retry after a network failure, clearer message when the CRM cannot be reached

item.title: Litigation Kiosk 1.5
item.description:
- Dynamics 365 CRM enrichment: sender -> contact/account, case references -> Legal Case, shown on lists and detail and given to Adam (read-only)
- Deadlines board: the CRM "Deadlines Today" view on the kiosk, under the tiles or on its own tab
- Dynamics signs in as the kiosk registration by default; a separate registration is optional
- Web admin: links to the right admin pages, debug log of every request, response and Adam transcript
- Toggles to hide the read-only note and the error banner on the kiosk screen

item.title: Litigation Kiosk 1.4
item.description:
- Remote admin from a laptop: switch on "Remote admin (web)" in Settings, open the address shown, log in with the Admin PIN. Edit all settings, categories and users, start a sync, see the state of play.
- Off by default; LAN only; 30 minute sessions; lockout after repeated bad PINs.

item.title: Litigation Kiosk 1.3
item.description:
- Email content is now PIN protected: tiles stay public, opening a tile or email asks for a PIN. Admin PIN starts as 5555 and must be changed on first use. Add named users with their own PINs in Settings. Relocks after 3 minutes idle.
- Each email in a list shows why Adam put it there.
- Email bodies are cleaned of quoted history, signatures, disclaimers and link wrapping; tap to see the original.

item.title: Litigation Kiosk 1.2
item.description: - Version bump to 1.2; first release delivered through the self-update feed.

item.title: Litigation Kiosk 1.1
item.description:
- Read-only: the kiosk never marks emails read; unread always mirrors Outlook.
- Live status bar: connecting, fetching, Adam classifying n of m.
- Classification runs until the queue is empty.
- Emails moved or archived out of the inbox drop off the tiles.
- First sync loads 14 days (configurable); later syncs fetch only new mail.
- Self-update from this feed. No credentials in the APK; see SETUP.txt.
